description: Track cryptocurrency prices and markets with CoinPaprika's data on some 53,000 coins across 350 exchanges. Price one coin or twenty at once in any of 42 currencies, chart a year of history, list the largest coins and busiest exchanges, look up what a project is and where its coin trades, and convert between any two currencies. Works with no account at all on CoinPaprika's free plan; add an API key for a paid plan's higher limits and fuller data.
